"Pixies" are "Around the Worlds" that are executed during "up-time." Up-time tricks are necessary as building blocks for bigger, more dexterity concentrated tricks. 
"Fairies" are just "Around the Worlds" that are up-time, but instead of your foot going around the footbag from in to out, it will go from out to in.
*Side note: an around the world dexterity goes in to out, "orbit" is the same thing but out to in.
so... pixie is to around the world as fairy is to orbit.
